title: MattBoard
tagline: A self-hosted wall display, laid out by drag and drop
summary: A smart display you hang on a wall and own outright, across three repositories: a React front end that draws the board and the drag-and-drop builder, an Express server on the same machine that holds the layout, the stored lists and every credential, and a multi-tenant hosted wrapper that adds Supabase accounts by composing the other two as submodules rather than forking them. AGPL licensed, no account and no subscription, and the target device is a Raspberry Pi driving a screen.

media.alt: MattBoard in normal wall-facing mode: to-do list, analog and digital clock, weather forecast and news headlines over a photo backdrop
media.caption: The board as it sits on the wall, with live weather from Open-Meteo, live RSS headlines and a photo pulled from a shared album.

media.alt: The same board in builder mode, showing a dot snap grid, dashed drag handles labelled todo, clock, news and weather, and an expanded toolbar
media.caption: Builder mode: every widget gets a labelled drag handle, the snap grid appears, and the toolbar grows theme, background, add, save and switch-layout buttons.

media.alt: The weather widget selected with a green outline and its settings popover open, offering Use Current Location, an address search and manual latitude and longitude fields
media.caption: Selecting a widget opens its own settings next to it, so the weather module is pointed at a location without leaving the board.

media.alt: The theme panel open over the board, with live previews of each widget and sliders for background, corner radius, text brightness, backdrop blur and font
media.caption: The theme panel previews every widget as you change it, and each widget can override the app-wide theme.
